_comment: Hardware inventory of ESP32-S3 sensing nodes. Source of truth for node_id ↔ MAC ↔ position. IPs may change with DHCP; that is intentional — node_id (provisioned into NVS) is the canonical identity used by the sensing-server.

4.notes: REMOVED 2026-06-07. ESP32-C6 (RISC-V) previously occupied the south position; it has been physically taken out of the deployment. The iOS app and Pi ip-map no longer expect a south node. Restore this entry, the iOS expectedRoster south row, and the Pi ip-map node id=4 entry when a south node is added back. scripts/reprovision-node7-to-node4.sh is preserved for that future use.

spare._comment: USB-to-serial chip IDs of the three currently-tethered nodes — for re-locating them physically.
